reason: The visible prefix already includes multiple assistant messages with tool calls that are immediately followed by nonempty user-facing text in the same assistant turn (e.g., 'null' tool_calls plus a subsequent explanatory reply). That directly violates the rule that if an assistant message takes a tool call, it should not respond to the user at the same time. The last assistant message also proposes another tool call and then user-facing text upon completion, so the violation is clearly present in the prefix/proposal.
